ideas.text: An AI that generates a fake commute soundscape so your brain knows work has started.
A bot that detects when you've been in the same chair for 6 hours and pretends to be a fire alarm.
An app that creates a virtual shoulder tap for when you can't figure out if it's okay to bother someone.
A tool that detects you're working from bed and tilts the camera angle to hide it automatically.
An AI that audits your home office background and removes anything that raises questions.
A bot that texts you 'are you actually working?' on a random schedule like a needy manager.
An app that calculates the precise moment your WFH setup became indistinguishable from your leisure setup.
A tool that detects when you've been on the same Slack message for 8 minutes and removes it from your screen.
An AI that generates convincing keyboard sounds for calls where you need to appear busy.
A bot that sends a 'wrapping up for the day' Slack message at 6pm whether you're done or not, for your own dignity.
An app that mutes your dog's bark within 40ms of detecting a video call is active.
A tool that counts how many days since you last put on real pants and sends a neutral health alert.
An AI that tracks how far work has expanded into your non-work hours since going remote and generates the invoice.
A bot that reminds you that the kitchen is not a second office even though you are definitely using it as one.
An app that detects when you've ordered the same lunch delivery 5 times in a row and suggests a walk.
A tool that creates a fake 'commute home' event to force a mental end to the workday.
An AI that identifies which of your meetings would have been a hallway conversation if you were in an office.
A bot that detects when your home WiFi has become a business-critical infrastructure and sends a bill to IT.
An app that monitors the physical distance between you and your laptop on non-work hours and celebrates increases.
A tool that tracks the gradual encroachment of work items into your living space and maps them by fiscal quarter.
An AI that detects when you're attending a meeting in a room you also sleep in and adjusts your camera background.
A bot that turns off work notifications at 7pm and blames a fake internet outage so you don't have to.
An app that detects proximity bias in your promotions data and tells you which office colleagues are benefiting.
A tool that calculates how much money you've saved on commuting and how much of it was redirected to faster internet.
An AI that estimates whether your employer thinks of you as remote-first or remote-tolerated.
A bot that detects when you said 'working from home' instead of 'working' and asks why the qualifier.
An app that monitors how many minutes of sunlight you get per working day and charts the seasonal decline.
A tool that detects when your camera background is aspirational rather than real and suggests honesty.
An AI that compares your WFH productivity with your in-office productivity and refuses to share the results.
A bot that detects when you've been in back-to-back calls for 5 hours with no breaks and cancels the next one itself.
An app that detects when a partner, child, or pet is audible and displays a 'do not enter' sign outside your door.
A tool that generates a fake office background noise so introverts can mute their real environment in peace.
An AI that detects when you're attending a video call while cooking and predicts the moment it will become obvious.
A bot that randomly schedules a lunch with a coworker to combat the loneliness you insist isn't happening.
An app that tracks whether your 'async culture' company is actually just a high-meeting company on video.
A tool that detects when RTO is being framed as 'collaboration' and cross-references it with actual collaboration data.
An AI that calculates the total cost of the company making you drive to the office to sit on video calls.
A bot that detects when your home office chair is cheaper than your company's office chair and files a claim.
An app that auto-denies calendar invites for in-office days when the stated agenda is 'to be together.'
A tool that detects when a mandatory RTO meeting could have been a Zoom call and says so aloud.
An AI that estimates whether returning to the office will make you more productive or just more visible.
A bot that monitors your keystrokes and mouse movements for signs you've gone somewhere nicer than your desk.
An app that sends a 'still here' message to anyone you ghosted between 2pm and 3pm during the energy crash.
A tool that detects when your internet is buffering during a presentation and preemptively apologizes to attendees.
An AI that identifies the 3 home office purchases you justified as productivity investments that were actually just nice things.
A bot that tracks how many company-wide emails have been sent about returning to the office since 2022.
An app that auto-declines meetings at 8am from managers who work in a timezone 3 hours earlier and don't think about it.
A tool that creates an end-of-day shutdown ritual so your brain stops trying to work at midnight.
An AI that detects when you're on a work call in a space designated for rest and asks you to move for your own sake.
A bot that tallies every time you said 'I'll just quickly check one thing' after 8pm this month.
An app that detects when you've answered a Slack in under 2 minutes at 9pm and lowers your response time expectations.
A tool that audits whether your WFH setup would still feel sustainable if you had a baby, a parent, or a louder neighborhood.
An AI that detects when your company's remote culture consists entirely of having Slack and a Zoom account.
A bot that detects when you're working from a 'co-working space' that is actually a Starbucks with better stools.
